bio.text: Keisha Lance Bottoms, a Democrat and former mayor of Atlanta, is a candidate for Governor of Georgia in 2026.
She served as mayor of Atlanta from 2018 to 2022 and previously served on the Atlanta City Council.
In June 2022 she joined the Biden administration as senior advisor and director of the White House Office of Public Engagement.

sources.title: Former Atlanta mayor Keisha Lance Bottoms announces 2026 Georgia governor run
